frame.description: 0-based frame index. Defaults to the active frame.

tools.name: read_region

height.description: Region height (default: to the canvas edge).

bloom_radius.description: Glow radius in output pixels (0 = auto).

lights.description: Point lights: [{position:[x,y,z], color, intensity, radius}] in model space (fires, windows, magic).

key_light.description: Key light direction (view space, toward the light).

ambient.description: Ambient multiplier (default 1; lower for night scenes).

pixel_palette.description: Pixel-art post-process: quantize the render to a library palette (e.g. 'endesga-32'), 'swatches', or N colors. Shared across all sprites of a sheet.

expectedRevision.description: Optimistic concurrency: fail with 'conflict' if the canvas revision differs (get it from canvas_inspect or any previous result).

operationId.description: Idempotency key: retrying with the same id never applies the change twice.

tools.name: voxel_pick
tools.title: Pick voxel at pixel
tools.description: Which voxel and face is under image pixel (px, py) for the given camera — used by 3D viewports for click editing.

model.description: Model index or name (default: the first model).

yaw.description: Turntable angle in degrees; 0 = front faces the camera, 90 = character faces screen-right.

pitch.description: Camera elevation in degrees (default 30; 0 = side view).

scale.description: Pixels per voxel. Omit to auto-fit the model.

focus.description: Model point to center in the image (close-ups, with scale).

frame.description: Animation time in frames (fractions allowed).

smoothness.description: 0 = crisp voxel faces (3D pixel look), 1 = smooth sprite shading (default 0.55).

outline.description: true/'selective' = pixel-art selective outline, or a hex outline color.

inner_lines.description: Darken depth edges inside the silhouette (separates limbs).

supersample.description: 1-4. 2 gives clean edges at small sprite sizes.

items.description: True color as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (any of 16.7M colors + 8-bit alpha), or 'transparent'.

background_gradient.description: [top, bottom] colors with a soft vignette (diorama look).
